record.question: Satisfaction with co-workers, promotion opportunities, the nature of work, and pay goes with high performance among those with strong growth needs. Among those with weak growth needs, no such relationship is present - and, in fact, satisfaction with promotion opportunities goes with low performance. This passage best supports the statement that:
options: relationship between job satisfaction and performance is moderated by growth need.
job satisfaction and performance are directly and closely related.
satisfaction is an inevitable organisational variable.
every organisation has few employees having weak growth need.
